metadata.scope: The terminal state is an evidence-policy verdict over Zetaris rows. A repository that is not NO_GO also gets a revival PRD with stage revive, refactor, and upgrade. This run does not clone, compile, test, or push commits. A row that passes the policy with no qualifying stage-1 success is CANDIDATE. RESURRECTED requires a stage-1 success on the fork default branch whose commit is ahead of the upstream base and whose workflow runs the repo's build or test commands. That success can override an upstream CI failure or unknown CI. It cannot override NO_GO, missing tests, or a missing licence file. A qualifying stage-1 failure is RESURRECTION_FAILED and cites that run. The latest attempt wins. Refactor and upgrade are an upgrade result and do not change the verdict. The trace hash chain shows the record was not altered after the run. It does not show that the record is true.
